title: 3D product hero (stylised stand-in)
summary: A studio product shot built in code: a generic bottle, can, jar, box or phone-like slab with the product's name on its label, rim-lit then swept by a key light on a seamless floor while the camera orbits or pushes in, with the name, a tagline and a call-to-action pill set beside it.
techniques: transparent WebGL over a painted backdrop
gallery_share: Rotating 3D product heroes are among the most common model-made commercial shorts.
limits: The product is a generic stand-in, never the real product's shape, label or logo; use a supplied model and a 3D provider (commercial.product-turntable) for fidelity
Five shapes only; no transmission, refraction, caustics or depth of field
Shadows are a soft contact blob, not ray-traced
Software WebGL: about 5-5.5 s of render per output second at 1080x1920; the optional bloom (glow) costs about 25 s per output second
